messages:
sarah: Quick heads-up — starting onboarding for model '13b-open-v2' today. Weights are at s3://redwood-models/onboard/13b-open-v2/2026-03-14/weights/ (sharded, 8 files). Plan: run AWQ -> GPTQ fallback -> FP8 experiment if AWQ quality looks OK.
anil: Nice. What tokenizer are we using for this one? Any quirks?
sarah: Using sentencepiece v0.1 with vocab_size=50000. Note: special_id for pad=0, unk=1, and we saw a weird extra BOS token in some exports. Fix is in the tokenizer.json here: `s3://redwood-models/onboard/13b-open-v2/tokenizer/tokenizer.json` — PR coming.
marie: How big is the calibration dataset for AWQ? Need to validate it covers chat-style prompts.
sarah: Planning 5k calibration prompts sampled from prod-sampled-prompts (balanced across completion lengths: <64, 64-512, >512). File: s3://redwood-models/onboard/13b-open-v2/calib/5k_march14.jsonl
qa_lead: What are the acceptance thresholds for AB tests / eval? We need numbers to sign off on canary.
sarah: Eval plan: 1) generation quality (ROUGE-L / exact match where applicable) should not degrade >1.5% on our high-priority prompts. 2) LLM-regression harness (1000 labeled prompts) top-1 accuracy drop <=1%. 3) latency p50 should stay within 10% of baseline hosted 13B. If AWQ fails, run GPTQ with 4-bit and FP16 baseline.
vincent: Any prior runs or sims to estimate AWQ delta? Last time AWQ gave ~0.8% median drop on long-form but very cheap.
anil: Product needs to sign off if accuracy >1% drop on prioritized prompts. I can review once you paste the eval table.
sarah: Uploaded initial eval CSV: s3://redwood-models/onboard/13b-open-v2/evals/awq_initial_eval.csv. Quick summary: overall avg drop 0.9%, but subset 'legal-qa' shows 2.4% drop.
marie: 2.4% on legal-qa is concerning. Can we rerun AWQ with larger calibration for that domain (2k extra prompts)?
sarah: Yes, will run domain-specific calib for legal with 2k added. Scheduling now. Command I ran:```bash
python tools/quant/run_awq.py --weights s3://redwood-models/onboard/13b-open-v2/weights/ --calib s3://redwood-models/onboard/13b-open-v2/calib/5k_march14.jsonl --out /tmp/13b-awq --bits 4 --group-size 128
```
devops-bot: Upload verified. Checks: checksum match, config schema v2 OK, tokenizer file present. Canary cluster slots available in us-west-2.
qa_lead: Also repro the FP8 run? Last time FP8 overflowed at layernorm for this arch. Need to capture NaNs and fall back.
sarah: FP8 run tried earlier failed w/ overflow in layernorm. Stack: `RuntimeError: Inf encountered in layernorm at block 23`. I'm adding per-layer scaling clamp and fallback to fp16 for older kernels. Will push a branch.
vincent: Can you post PR for quant configs and runtime flags? I'll review. Also request SRE to reserve canary capacity.
sarah: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtimes/pull/482 — includes AWQ calib script, config changes, and canary rollout yaml.
anil: I need the eval CSV + a diff view vs baseline. Attach that and I'll review before product sign-off.
sarah: Pasted summary in PR and uploaded full diffs. Key lines: `legal-qa: -2.4%, longform-summ: -0.7%, chat-bench: -0.3%`.
marie: After domain recalib for legal (2k extra), can we expect improvement? Any ballpark?
sarah: Expect 0.5–1.5% improvement on that domain. If not enough, plan B = GPTQ 4-bit with per-channel quant and a small distill step.
qa_lead: For canary, propose 5% traffic for 48hrs, collect ROUGE, latency, errors. If pass, ramp to 25% for 24hrs.
anil: Product OK with that gating. Need security checklist for private deployments (no customer data in leaves).
vincent: SRE pinged for capacity — @devops-bot any ETA for canary schedule?
devops-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-03-15T22:00:00Z -> 2026-03-17T22:00:00Z, 5% traffic in us-west-2, cluster: onboard-canary-13b. Health hooks + tracing enabled.
marie: One more ask: add a regression alert to Console for 'legal-qa' metric crossing -1.5% within the canary window.
sarah: done — alert rule added in console (rule id 7901).
vincent: I'm +1 on the rollout plan pending final eval after the legal recalib. I'll review the PR tomorrow.
anil: Reviewed the diffs — product gives conditional sign-off: if legal-qa delta <=1.5% after recalib, sgtm for canary.
qa_lead: I'll run the gold-standard tests after recalib completes.
sarah: Thanks. Will update thread when recalib results are in and attach new CSV.
devops-bot: Note: deployment job link https://ci.redwood-inference.com/jobs/55678 started for AWQ artifact build.
vincent: Thanks everyone. Ping me if you need an emergency rollback — I watched the rollout yaml.
marie: ack :thumbsup:
